title: Motorola SWTV-24AE-FHD (Skyworth OEM, device beomil, product SW11_TG, MediaTek), India/Global
header:
Motorola SWTV-24AE-FHD (Skyworth OEM, device beomil, product SW11_TG, MediaTek), India/Global
Android TV 14 (API 34), build UKN4.250714.138, security patch 2025-10-01.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV).
Setup wizard: com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith (claims HOME with priority 1).
Live TV app: com.cltv.hybrid (iWedia CanaliTV).
HDMI and tuner inputs: com.mediatek.tvinput.
Remote: Settings button emits keycode 83 (KEYCODE_NOTIFICATION) on scancode 240; needs HomeKeyService.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/motorola-swtv-24ae-fhd/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/motorola-swtv-24ae-fhd/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

WARNING: If Wi-Fi was set up during the first-run wizard, the saved network belongs to setupwraith
and Android DELETES it the moment setupwraith is disabled; the TV drops off the network and ADB with it.
Check first: `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'`. If it is not android.uid.system, forget the network
and re-join it in Settings > Network BEFORE disabling setupwraith.

apps.note: "after-sale" service: boot + network receivers, can install APKs
partner config that injects rows into the home screen
